[n_02cc84da158d] Defect · OKL_DATABASE_URL was honoured by the store and ignored by every CLI command
symptom: a documented storage env var works in one entry point and is silently overridden in another; writes land somewhere other than where the operator pointed them
fix: resolve the storage target in ONE place that every entry point calls; if a component deliberately ignores the variable, refuse loudly rather than silently substituting a default

[n_58119d0a63d9] Rule · Init must wire, not instruct — every 'now copy X / add Y to config' printout is a surface nobody runs
symptom: an installer prints manual follow-up steps (register this hook, copy this workflow, add to settings)
fix: make init perform each registration itself, idempotent and non-clobbering; warn loudly only for what it truly cannot do (e.g. no git repo -> drift disabled)

[n_713b8c104f12] Defect · An empty result and a mistyped filter must not look identical
symptom: a query with a filter flag returns zero rows and exit 0, and the flag value was never validated
fix: validate the filter's FORM and refuse a malformed one with exit 2; for a well-formed value the data has never seen, still run but say so and name the values that do exist

[n_e7988ff536fb] Rule · Exit codes are this CLI's public API: 0 clean, 1 findings, 2 refused
symptom: a new command, or a new error path in an existing one, that returns 0 or 1 on a condition meaning 'this did not run'
fix: return 2 and print the reason to stderr; add a test asserting the code and that stdout stayed empty

[n_ec568941f68a] Defect · Honouring a config source in the resolver but not in the 'is it configured' gate splits read from write
symptom: one command accepts a store location and a sibling command refuses the same location as unconfigured
fix: every source that can name the target must be recognised by the gate that decides whether one was named; when widening the gate, check what the gate was originally protecting is still caught somewhere

[n_967ef9825472] Rule · Anything written into someone else's repo is idempotent and non-clobbering; anything derived migrates on open
symptom: a schema/index change with no migration path, or an installer that overwrites a file it did not write
fix: detect the old shape on open and rebuild from the canonical table; write only when absent unless --force, and test the second run

[n_916330f61994] Rule · A comment asserting a safety property is not the property
symptom: a comment justifying a decision by asserting an invariant, with no test or code enforcing it
fix: make the claim executable — write the file, then assert git would not stage the secret

[n_e635fd921086] Defect · PyPI rejects a package name as 'too similar' to an existing one — with a bare 400 that hides the reason
symptom: twine upload returns '400 Bad Request' with no explanation, after the file uploads to 100%
fix: run twine upload --verbose to read PyPI's real message; on a similarity block, rename only the [project] name and keep the console_scripts entry point

[n_b0457b37c65a] Decision · A controlled vocabulary is closed per store, not fixed in the package
symptom: a validated vocabulary ships as a constant, so a team using a language or subject the authors did not anticipate must fork to file a lesson
fix: keep the shipped set as a FLOOR and let the store declare additions as records; validate against floor union declared, and validate the declaration itself against the floor only so the first one is writable

[n_5ddb0776a863] Defect · A CI gate that reads gitignored state checks nothing in CI, and passes
symptom: a gate is green on every PR and never red, and the data it inspects lives in a file the repository ignores
fix: make the gate count what it inspected and treat zero as 'did not run' (its own exit code), never as clean; then decide explicitly how CI gets the data, rather than letting its absence read as success. The same holds for any report or summary line that states a clean result: carry the inspected count beside it and say 'unknown' at zero (okl recap --report printed 'every lesson is proven' with drift having checked nothing, caught in review on okl #281, 2026-10-24)

[seed:rag-defects:qz_judge_crash] Defect · 'LLM Judge 5.0/5.0' while 19 of 20 cases crashed — a metric that can't report its own failure rate
symptom: a summary score prints while some cases threw or were skipped
fix: lead the report with the crash/failure count; mark results unusable above threshold

[n_90066f354f1e] Defect · A recorded lesson protects reasoning; only a merged fix protects execution
symptom: a defect the store already knows about recurs in the same session, in a branch cut from a base that predates its fix
fix: when later work depends on a fix that is still in review, branch from the branch that carries it, not from main; and read a recurrence as a question about where the fix LIVES, not about whether the lesson was written down

[n_a7634ef53a8f] Decision · The encoding loop has no runtime input — every lesson enters from author time or CI time
symptom: a defect class that only a running system reveals (pagination silently dropped, a limit hit under real load, a partial-failure path) has no way into the store until a human finds it some other way
fix: treat observability as a SOURCE of records rather than a competitor to them: when a runtime-only defect is found, record it with found_by naming the trace or metric that showed it; do not claim the loop covers runtime until some record actually cites one

[n_69f673496137] Rule · Verify-by-making-it-fail applies to throwaway diagnostics, not just committed tests
symptom: an ad-hoc shell or one-off script check reports a clean result across every input, and the clean result is the check silently not working
fix: before believing a negative from a hand-rolled check, run it against a case known to be positive; if it cannot produce the failure it screens for, it is not evidence — and note that a no-match grep exits non-zero, so '|| echo 0' converts a broken check into a reassuring one. The same holds in reverse: before believing a positive, run the check against a case known to be negative. A background watcher reported two PRs as reviewed when the bot had only rate-limited them, because an empty jq result passed through tr '\n' ' ' became a single space and [ -n "$x" ] read it as text (okl #280/#281, 2026-10-24). Count results (jq length) and compare numbers, never test captured text for emptiness

symptom: a committed diagram or doc states counts, thresholds or shapes that someone transcribed by hand
fix: generate the artifact from the live system and add a freshness test that regenerates and diffs; trace against committed inputs, never a developer's local state, or the test passes only on the machine that last rendered it

[n_696a70084e1a] Defect · Importing verification records through the normal write path re-stamps them — a CI store seeded that way can never drift
symptom: a plan to give CI a store by loading committed records with the ordinary import/seed command, where the records carry a verified-at or last-checked timestamp
fix: load audit state through a reader that preserves the recorded timestamps (okl drift --snapshot builds nodes in memory), read only the committed copy, and refuse entries whose timestamp does not match its evidence stamp

[n_805cf67e5cc5] Defect · Drift misses a change committed within the same second as a verification
symptom: a file edited and committed immediately after okl verify does not show as drift
fix: record the commit the check passed at and compare the governed files' CONTENT there with HEAD (git diff --quiet <commit> HEAD -- <paths>); fall back to time only when the clone lacks the commit; bind the commit into tamper-evident evidence; test with a pinned same-second commit date, never a sleep

[n_31bde92d9003] Rule · Verification stamps come from observed checks with stored evidence — never from the claimant's assertion
symptom: a 'verified' flag settable by whoever makes the claim, with no record of what check (if any) backed it
fix: no run, no stamp: verification API takes evidence produced by an executed check; keep assertion-based flags only for importing historical receipts

[empty-drift-snapshot-fails-ci] Defect · A committed drift snapshot with zero rules fails CI, and okl verify never creates the first one
symptom: a new user commits okl-drift.json on day one, before any lesson has --files, and the okl-verify CI step fails with 'NOTHING CHECKED' (exit 2); or a user verifies a lesson and finds no okl-drift.json to commit
fix: commit okl-drift.json only once a lesson governs files: run okl export --drift once, then let okl verify refresh it; documented in the Quickstart. Candidate code fix: have export --drift refuse (exit 2) to write a snapshot with zero rules, so the trap cannot be set

[n_37ea04a8a0ac] Rule · Shareable artifacts get generic descriptors; internal records keep real provenance — sanitize the copy, not the source
symptom: a diagram, post, or slide meant for an outside audience names internal repos/projects/paths, or a sanitizing pass reaches into the seed data and provenance records
fix: before sharing, grep the artifact for internal names and replace with stack-level descriptors; leave seed files, repo fields, and found_by trails untouched

[n_b40a468119f6] Defect · A tag on some records is not a verdict on the collection they sit in
symptom: a whole pack, batch or corpus is recommended or filtered because a few of its records share one label with the target
fix: decide collection fit by what the collection is ABOUT (its stack), not by any single shared subject; and prove the matcher red on a stack-mismatched pack that shares a subject

[n_09ba6adf0fdc] Decision · A committed snapshot of store state is a one-way export — never import it back into the store
symptom: a proposal to load okl-drift.json (or any committed export of a store) back into the store, or to sync stores through a committed file
fix: keep the snapshot derived from the store and read-only; sync stores through the service, never through a committed file

[n_e49be14d6207] Defect · A test suite that reads the storage env var writes its fixtures into the real store
symptom: a suite goes red on unrelated tests right after a storage variable was exported for other work, and the real store gains records with fixture-looking titles
fix: an autouse conftest fixture strips every storage-naming variable for every test; prove it by running the suite with the variable exported and asserting the real store's record count is unchanged; set such variables per command, never exported

[n_b83c550a0ca4] Decision · okl stores lessons as typed records found by full-text search, not an ontology store; RDF is a one-way export when something needs it
symptom: a proposal to ingest an ontology, store lessons as RDF triples, or query them with SPARQL or a graph database
fix: keep records, FTS and one-step relationships; when a consumer needs RDF, add a one-way JSON-LD export (never imported back, tested with a real RDF parser); revisit only on a consumer, on exposure-log or A/B misses that cluster around same-concept-different-words (try a measured term map first), or if the job becomes reasoning over a shared concept hierarchy

[n_ce6a27cc432f] Defect · A resolver that falls back to a default location turns a missing setup into a successful write nobody reads
symptom: a write command run before setup, or in the wrong directory, exits 0, and the data never appears where every reader looks
fix: make the resolver refuse when nothing names the target (one exception the entry point turns into 'could not run'), instead of guarding commands one at a time; test that every command exits 2, prints nothing to stdout, and leaves no file behind

[n_428707b5e596] Defect · A hook that fires is not a hook that's heard — PreToolUse stdout never reaches the model, so the 'enforced read' was silently unread
symptom: a context-injecting hook logs as fired, its output is correct, and the agent's behavior is unchanged
fix: deliver briefings via UserPromptSubmit (stdout -> context, stdin carries the real prompt as the task, exit 2 fails closed); keep an E2E behavioral test with a bare control repo. Plain PreToolUse stdout still never reaches the model; PreToolUse JSON additionalContext now does, so tool-time context is possible (see [pretooluse-additionalcontext]) and needs the same E2E test before anyone relies on it

fix: install stop-okl-encode.sh (okl init or okl scaffold) and register it under hooks.Stop

symptom: a reviewer in a consumer repo flags generated text describing a gate, step or file that repo was set up without
fix: when a feature becomes optional, grep every shipped template for sentences that assume it and reword them to what holds in every configuration (here: the briefing and okl drift mark the lesson STALE; a gate fails where installed). Fix generated files upstream in the template, never in the consumer repo.

fix: type every request model, closed with extra='forbid'; and validate types at the domain's write path too (Node.validate here), so a bad value is refused before it is stored whichever entry point sent it

[n_3dac3a1d8fba] Rule · Findability and ranking are separate properties — a test asserting one can pass while the other is off
symptom: a retrieval feature's test stays green after the feature is disabled, because the assertion checks that a record is FOUND rather than where it RANKS
fix: bound a ranking weight from both sides: assert the record is found, assert it does not outrank real content, and assert the weight constant itself is above zero — the first two pass at weight zero

[rerank-ships-off] Decision · The cross-encoder second stage ships off: it reorders both ways and its scores cannot replace the relevance floor
symptom: a proposal to make okl check --rerank the default, to admit a candidate by its reranker rank or score, or to try another passage cross-encoder on the same pool
fix: keep --rerank, OKL_RERANK and the config key off by default and documented as the measured experiment. REPORT §4u then settled both follow-ups: no cosine-plus-rank line admits a lifted lesson without admitting chat filler (admission grid), and the floor's two-word rule for semantic-only candidates admits the one lesson it was built for while the cutoff still drops it behind fifteen kept records (reverted to None). The next retrieval pre-registration is the ORDER among kept records (title/symptom/alias matches over body matches, or a per-type cutoff), measured first on the six prompts; do not re-run a passage cross-encoder on this pool or re-measure these two rules expecting a different answer.

[diagnostic-on-stage-window] Rule · A diagnostic computed over a different candidate pool than the stage under test reports ranks the stage never produced
symptom: a probe or receipt shows a record at rank 1 or 2 for a stage, yet the stage's own output never contained it; the recall column and the rank column disagree in both directions
fix: compute every diagnostic column on the stage's own window, with the stage's own parameters; when a wider list is needed for ranks beyond the window, append it after the stage's list rather than running the stage on it; before writing a result, spot-check one row the diagnostic calls a gain against the real call's output

[n_5a9589af345f] Defect · A remote write path that hides validation errors as outages — the agent couldn't tell 'bad tag' from 'service down'
symptom: an agent's record attempts fail with HTTP 500 / 'unreachable' while the service is healthy; the agent invented values outside a closed vocabulary
fix: map validation errors to 400 with detail; client raises ValueError with the detail on 4xx and OKLUnreachable only on network/5xx; apply repo default before the mode branch

[falsifier-relative-to-control] Rule · A pre-registered falsifier is written relative to the control arm measured on the same store, never as an absolute figure
symptom: a pre-registered falsifier fires on the control arm itself, or no cell of a calibration grid can satisfy the selection rule because the baseline already violates it
fix: state every falsifier as a difference from the control arm (the same prompts, the same store, run in the same session), with the allowed size named; when a baseline figure is quoted in the pre-registration, re-measure it on the store the change will run on before writing it; after the fact, apply the rule as written and say so, then report the relative reading beside it rather than quietly substituting the one that passes. A shipping bar is a different thing: a level a feature must reach to be turned on may be absolute, as long as it is labelled a bar and not used to test whether an effect exists
